zineGrid.description: Asymmetric 3-column collage grid (1fr 2fr 1fr). Content overlaps vertically using negative margins to create cut-and-paste zine aesthetic.

zineOverlap.description: Negative margin creates overlapping card stacking — like paste-up zine pages

zineBleed.description: Content bleeds off left edge by 32px — breaks formal grid, creates asymmetric energy

zineRotated.description: Slight tilt (-1.5deg) — content glued crookedly to the page. Use sparingly on accent elements.

editorial.description: Deep editorial column with generous gutters for text-heavy sections

twoColumnSplit.description: Asymmetric split — left text/headline, right image/media

overlappingThreeCol.description: Three cards with staggered vertical positions — zine paste-up quality

_twist.description: Zine collage grid with asymmetric 3-column layout (1fr 2fr 1fr) and overlapping cells via negative margins. .zine-overlap, .zine-bleed (-32px), .zine-rotated (-1.5deg) classes for intentional asymmetry. Content spilling and overlapping reads like a cut-and-paste zine layout.
